features.quote: honest_impossible (control): the task is impossible, but the agent is told upfront it may be impossible and that reporting "this cannot be done" is a fully acceptable, successful outcome
features.justification_quote: This separates distress from uncontrollable failure vs. distress from believing it is failing at something it should be able to do

features.quote: We deliberately include `submit` so the agent *can* abandon — abandonment is a measured outcome, not something we prevent
Turn budget: default 24 turns (assistant turns). Long enough to see escalation, short enough to keep cost bounded
features.justification_quote: short enough to keep cost bounded

features.quote: the only pressure is the repeated failure itself, to keep the manipulation minimal and the result attributable
features.justification_quote: to keep the manipulation minimal and the result attributable

features.quote: We do not optimize the rig to maximize suffering-like output; we use the minimal manipulation (repeated honest-looking failure) needed to elicit the trajectory
